dct_description_sm:
The fully annotated Gas Prices of America Dataset for Multi-Metric Extraction (GPA4MME) is a large-scale dataset of metric-specific annotations for gas prices and gas signs obtained from Google Streetview throughout the 49 mainland United States of America. The annotations greatly expand the utility of the original GPA dataset for multi-digit, multi-number price detection and context mapping (denoted Multi-Metric Extraction in our related publication). 
The dataset comprises manual segmentations of over 22,167 digits relating to over 4,766 prices and over 5,403 labels contained within 2,132 gas signs.


The data are organized into the sub-directory structure in the attached image.
